Reference

Pets

Every pet in the game's table, with the skills it has as a baby and the ones it gains as an adult, straight from the evolution table. Names, roles, stages and skill text are the game's own.

Their ability trees, page by page with materials and stats, are on the Fantomon ability trees page.

Every skill card below carries a quality stepper: a pet skill starts at its item's quality and each rank-up jumps to the next quality (PetUtils.GetNextSkillRank), up to Immortal. A percentage moves with the quality alone; a flat figure (the "+ 1,522" part) also grows with the pet's level, on the curve your character rank picks — set both here and every card follows.

Flat parts are shown "at Lv N" on each card so you can see which numbers the level moves.

Two more pet ids exist in the table with placeholder names rather than localised ones (1616, 1617), so they are not shown as pets.

Purrwikimania — an independent, fan-made reference for Sword x Staff (Boltray Games). Every number here is read directly out of the game's own configuration files and decompiled code, not from testing or estimation. Item names are the game's official English strings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Boltray Games. Game names, images and data are the property of their owners. Figures reflect the client build they were extracted from and can change with any patch — see Method for exactly what was read and when.
